ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Funding Freeze on Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the $91 million Medicaid funding freeze on healthcare services in Minnesota
questions: How will the funding freeze affect healthcare services?
What are the potential long-term consequences?
ideas.insight: The freeze could have significant implications for healthcare access and quality in Minnesota, particularly for vulnerable populations.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Source of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Dig into the specifics of the Medicaid fraud case that led to the funding freeze
questions: What are the details of the fraud case?
ideas.insight: Understanding the source of the fraud could help prevent similar cases in the future.
